answer: Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Because the rationale is hashed into the saffron record and indexed in the river history, the pearl audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 53 aliases therefore needs 53 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
